story.label: WHO WE ARE
story.title: Our Story Is About Yours.
story.body: What began as a way to help international students find their footing in New York has grown into something more. Today, OSSC brings together businesses that support people as they learn, work, live, and grow.

businesses.label: OUR BUSINESSES
businesses.title: A Group Built Around Your Life.
businesses.body: From finding a place to call home to pursuing education, building a career, and caring for your well-being, our businesses support the different needs of everyday life.

groups.title: Real Estate & Lifestyle
groups.body: Making everyday life easier through housing, insurance, logistics, and essential services.

groups.title: Education & Career
groups.body: Helping students and professionals navigate education, career opportunities, and their next steps.

groups.title: Health & Wellness
groups.body: Supporting personal health, confidence, and well-being through specialized care and services.

groups.title: Regional Services & Community
